# konnect_organization_ip_allow_list (Resource)

OrganizationIPAllowList Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_organization_ip_allow_list" "my_organizationipallowlist" {
  allowed_ips = [
    "192.168.1.1",
    "192.168.1.0/22",
  ]
  enabled         = true
  organization_id = "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_ips` (Set of String) The list of allowed IPs for the organization.
- `organization_id` (String) A UUID representing an organization.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether ip allow list is enabled for the organization. Default: false

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_organization_ip_allow_list.my_konnect_organization_ip_allow_list
  id = "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_organization_ip_allow_list.my_konnect_organization_ip_allow_list "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
```
